# Fixture Project Constitution
<!-- Example: Spec Constitution, TaskFlow Constitution [GUIDANCE_FILE] -->

## Core Principles

### I. Tests before code
Every change lands with a failing test first; the red run is recorded
before the fix is written.

### II. Pure stdout
Tools print machine-readable output on stdout and every diagnostic on
stderr; the two never mix.

## Governance

Amendments require a recorded ruling from the owner. Normative
language follows [RFC2119].

**Version**: 1.0.0 | **Ratified**: 2026-08-22
